description: This file defines the TemplateImage class, which extends the TemplateText class to represent image field templates in the SuiteCRM application. It manages image-specific properties such as border, width, and height, and provides mechanisms for defining field definitions and setting property values.

classes.name: TemplateImage
classes.description: Represents an image field template in SuiteCRM, extending the TemplateText class and adding image-specific properties and methods.

methods.name: get_field_def
methods.description: Returns the definition array for the image field, including properties like studio visibility, type, database type, length, and optional border, width, and height based on object properties.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the vardef_map to map 'border', 'width', and 'height' properties to external variables 'ext1', 'ext2', and 'ext3'.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the field properties from input values and updates object properties 'border', 'width', and 'height' from corresponding external variables if they are not empty.
